items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker (groin): getting better but don't want to do something stupid; Levitan agrees playing him <100% is stupid, especially with huge Week 12 at BUF and Chiefs 15.5-pt home favorites vs ARI (Carson Beck). Expect caution/another sit.
items.why: Reid day-to-day comments + schedule (Thanksgiving short week next); Emmett Johnson monster fill-in prior week
items.implication: Walker likely misses or limited W11; monitor practice; handcuff/backup elevated

items.text: Eagles HC Nick Sirianni said QB Joe Milton will start Sunday vs. the Steelers (implying Jalen Hurts sidelined).
items.implication: Hurts out; Eagles offense/ dual-threat scoring hit; Saquon/WRs adjust to backup QB
items.opportunity: Possible more designed runs or checkdowns

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury (strain from Week 9); in/out of boot during bye, Jalon Daniels taking starter reps. Status uncertain/trending miss for W11 vs DET.
items.why: Foot/ankle from W9; rehab during bye incomplete
items.implication: Likely miss or GTD; Daniels starts; Bucs pass catchers/RBs (Irving) volume shifts possible in run-lean script
items.opportunity: Elevated RB/ dual-threat if backup QB

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.

No IR for Jordan Addison (thumb surgery successful Monday); O'Connell positive on timeline, back at facility, will not go short-term IR as of now. Still expected multi-week absence but shorter than 4-game IR min.
items.why: Successful surgery, encouraging rehab timeline vs prior IR expectation
items.implication: Hold in most leagues for fantasy playoffs; out W11/likely W12; Jefferson volume remains elevated short-term
items.opportunity: Continued targets to Jefferson/other Vikes WRs

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot; positive for pass-catchers especially with Jefferson.
items.why: PROE spike confirms O'Connell pass-first intent even prior; Cousins enables it
items.implication: Jefferson/Vikes pass game ROS upgrade; favorable playoff DvP too (DET/WAS/NYJ)

items.text: Omarion Hampton finally got lead-back volume: 22 carries, 105 yards, a touchdown, and 63% of the snaps. With six teams on bye, he’s a start against the Jets.
items.why: Lead volume/snaps confirmed W10; soft Jets matchup amid byes
items.opportunity: High carries + snap share vs weak run D
items.conflict: Some analysts still hesitant on LAC offense

items.text: Closing it out on Jaylen Waddle: target share is nice, the production is not.
items.implication: Sit/downgrade W11 and near-term; look elsewhere in DEN offense

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.implication: DET pass rush hit; minor fantasy (team defense); Joseph returns secondary

items.text: New Team-by-Team show: most important notes on all 32 franchises heading into Week 11 (with Evan Silva).
items.why: Comprehensive franchise notes for W11 prep

items.text: ETR has Jonathan Taylor ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead.
items.implication: JT preferred half-PPR ROS; Brown PPR bump from receiving

items.text: Kaelon Black available in 61% Yahoo; 60+ scrimmage yards three straight, scored twice past three; viable flex even with CMC healthy. Top RB waiver target.
items.implication: Priority add in bye-heavy week; stash or flex
items.opportunity: Shared but productive SF backfield snaps/carries

items.text: Week 11 Waiver Wire (Daigle): FAAB guidance, drop list, injury report, streaming options amid six-team bye and injuries.
items.why: Bye-mageddon + injury cascade creates streaming/FAAB needs
items.implication: Prioritize volume handcuffs and streamers; check injury report section
